title: Welcome to DRisk
summary: A short introduction to the DRisk compliance platform and the journey covered by this Help Centre.

blocks.text: DRisk is a compliance platform intended to help organisations organise compliance work, understand requirements, manage controls and supporting evidence, and review readiness. This article is a draft placeholder for the approved product introduction.

The Help Centre follows a typical journey: understand the platform, select a framework, review requirements, define controls, add evidence, and assess readiness. The exact screens and workflow should be confirmed with the product team before publication.

items: Confirm that you have access to the DRisk environment provided by your organisation.
